headline: Travis County Home Backup Report
summary: Homes in Travis County face an elevated risk. Records from 2018 show a long outage about once every 8 years. In February 2021, 43% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 74 hours. In February 2023, 29% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 106 hours. One Core lasts about 18 hours in August. One Core lasts about 44 hours in February. Two Cores last about 34 hours in August. Two Cores cover 93% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
